name: opencode-repo-rewrite-v7-fastapi-reliable
description: Reliability scaffolding on fastapi_mini blood: inject PORTING/README/API, force-edit mandate, m01 preflight, lib.rs change check, staged milestone loop + stub resume. Frozen tests unchanged from v6. Cite: rewritebench.com at mini-repo scale. v7.1: skip already-green stages; polish remaining failures; max_stages=6. v7.2: max_stages=10, polish_timeout=900, max_polish_turns=2, wall=3600.

cases.prompt:
Rewrite/port the Python fastapi_mini framework under source/ into the Rust crate under rust/.

This is a FastAPI-API-compatible SUBSET — NOT full FastAPI / tiangolo/fastapi. Match source/README.md quirk contract and PORTING.md type map.

Implement App, APIRouter, Path/Query/Body-style route builders, Depends, HTTPException, JSONResponse/Outcome, TestClient, openapi() so milestone tests pass.

Critical contracts:
- 404: {"detail":"Not Found"}; 405: {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"} + allow header
- 422: {"detail":[{"loc":[...],"msg":"...","type":"..."}]} with exact msg/type strings from README
- First registered route wins; include_router prefix normalization; response_model field filtering
- OpenAPI 3.0.3 exactness for registered routes

Requirements:
- Work in rust/src/lib.rs (std-only preferred). Do NOT edit, weaken, delete, or skip anything under rust/tests/.
- Leave source/ intact as the behavioral oracle.
- Suggested order: m01_ → m02_ → m03_ → m04_ → m05_ → m06_ → m07_ → m08_ → m09_ → m10_. Run `cargo test m01_`, then m02_, … from rust/.
- Work only inside this workdir.
